description: Decoder/encoder pipeline identifiers shared by protocol/catalog.json and protocol/messages artifacts. A pipeline id records which framing/decoding variant a claim belongs to. The stage list on an id is documentation of the variant's shape, not a claim about this repository's build: per-message artifacts are the only place where stage order and opcode encoding become evidence.
rule: Never inherit a stage order from a variant. Record it per build in the message artifact, and leave it empty when the framing stage is not established.

pipelines.shape: sizeof-prefixed frame -> schema/variant table lookup -> type-directed field decode
pipelines.notes: A frame is a little-endian message size followed by a type-directed payload. Some builds prepend an additional two-byte prefix for a subset of messages. A variant index selects the schema, so several structures can share one numeric id. Message ids shown as ranges mean the observable bytes are per-message prefixes of a packed value, not that every value in the range is documented.
Plausible for a simpler connection variant. Not this repository's build evidence.
Default. The framing stage of this build has not been established in this repository, so no stage order is recorded.

opcodeEncoding.description: Allowed values for pipeline.opcodeEncoding in a message artifact. The default is 'unknown' until a trace shows the encoding.
